components.rule: Binary documented formal educational pathway; multiple degrees/certificates at the same host do not multiply the score. Display quantum-materials-specific vs broader QIS separately.
Count distinct listed labs/centers, saturating at 4. Mark this as selected-directory coverage; do not count cross-listed Programs records twice.

Optional separate funding lens. Use deduplicated NSF award obligations or another precisely labeled consistent amount type, assigned to the named lead recipient only. Display period and scope. Do not compare selected center commitments to an institution’s total funding.

weightingRecommendation.defaultRecommendation: Prefer transparent evidence badges and separate education / centers / verified-funding lenses. If a combined score is shown, keep weights visible and adjustable; expose all numerator records. Keep unknown funding visually unknown, not $0.
weightingRecommendation.importantLimit: The directory was intentionally selected, so any score measures evidence captured here, not the strongest universities worldwide.
